function.name: agent13_health
function.description: Inspect OS Lab Agent 13 service status, configured root and file-overwrite limitations.

function.name: agent13_plan
function.description: Preview best-effort overwriting and deletion of ONE explicitly identified regular file relative to the service root. This changes no contents. Show the result and limitations to the human and obtain approval of that exact file before calling agent13_execute. Never infer permission for other files or promise unrecoverability.

path.description: Relative path; absolute paths, traversal and symlinks are forbidden.

function.name: agent13_execute
function.description: Destructive: overwrite, fsync and unlink the file pinned by a live agent13_plan token. Call only after the human authorizes this exact plan and acknowledges the limitations. A token is consumed even if native execution fails. Partial overwrite is irreversible; inspect failure details, never blindly retry.

function.name: agent13_cancel
function.description: Release a prepared file and its lock without overwriting or deleting it.
